fonts.usage: H1, H2, massive kinetic numbers, main hero text
H3, H4, small overlines, component labels

scale.h1: text-6xl md:text-8xl lg:text-[10vw] uppercase tracking-tighter leading-none
scale.overline: text-xs md:text-sm uppercase tracking-[0.2em] text-red-500 font-bold

typography.installation_instructions: Add Google Fonts links in public/index.html for Bebas Neue, Outfit, and Manrope.

surfaces.name: Editorial Cards
surfaces.classes: bg-[#121212] border border-[#262626] hover:border-red-600 transition-colors duration-300

effects.grain: Use a subtle SVG noise overlay fixed to the background to give a gritty, documentary feel.
effects.shadows: Hard, flat shadows for buttons (Brutalist sports style) rather than soft diffuse shadows.

layouts.grid_system: The 'Tetris' Grid (Mode A) for marketing/portfolio pages. Use grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-12 with gap-6 or gap-8.
layouts.spacing: Generous spacing. py-24 or py-32 for section paddings. Container padding px-4 md:px-8.
layouts.alignment: Left-align mostly for editorial feel. Center-align only for massive manifesto numbers.

buttons.primary: bg-[#E60000] text-white uppercase font-bold tracking-widest px-8 py-4 hover:bg-white hover:text-black transition-colors duration-300
buttons.outline: border border-[#262626] text-white px-8 py-4 hover:border-white transition-colors duration-300

hero.style: Kinetic Hero. Full viewport height. Background image with bg-black/60 overlay. Text uses Framer Motion for line-by-line reveal. Text must be MASSIVE.
hero.content: Title 'Din Colțul Cuștii'. Main text: 'MMA-ul din spatele ecranelor. Lecții reale din antrenamente, competiții, victorii și înfrângeri. Drumul unui luptător de la zero spre performanță.'

manifesto_list.style: Numbered chapters for Mindset section. Huge stroke numbers (e.g., text-stroke text-transparent) positioned absolutely behind the text.

timeline.style: Vertical line on left side. Nodes for each competition. High contrast text.

marquee.style: Fast-moving kinetic typography band to separate sections. Massive outline text or solid red bar.

motion.scroll: MUST implement Lenis for smooth momentum scrolling. This is critical for the premium Awwwards feel.

animations.text_reveal: Line-by-line mask reveal for headings (y: 100%, opacity: 0 to y: 0, opacity: 1, overflow: hidden on parent).
animations.parallax: Hero image should scale/translate slightly on scroll.
animations.hover: Images in article grids should scale up slightly (scale 1.05) inside a hidden overflow container.

image_urls.description: Moody shot of a muscular MMA fighter seen through the cage at night.
A black and white photo of two men boxing
A serious MMA fighter standing in a cage arena, ready for competition.
Pair of red boxing gloves in the dark.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure pure white text on deep black/red backgrounds meets WCAG AAA.
accessibility.motion: Respect prefers-reduced-motion for Lenis and Framer Motion.
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements MUST have data-testid attributes.

instructions_to_main_agent: Execute in Javascript, not Typescript (use .js and .jsx files).
Install required dependencies: framer-motion, @studio-freight/react-lenis, react-fast-marquee, lucide-react, clsx, tailwind-merge.
Set up Tailwind colors in index.css to match the Deep Obsidian background and Electric Crimson accent.

The Hero section must feature the provided cage portrait image as a background with a heavy bg-black/50 or bg-black/60 overlay. Use Framer motion to animate the text 'Din Colțul Cuștii' in a staggering line reveal.
Create a responsive Navbar that floats and uses a backdrop blur.
Implement the 'About Me' section as an asymmetrical Bento grid.
Implement the 'Mindset' section using large, brutalist, transparent outline numbers (text-stroke) behind the text.
Build the blog 'Articles' section with heavy bottom borders and a clean editorial feel.
Never use generic placeholder image URLs. Use the provided Unsplash/Pexels URLs.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Do not use complete transparent backgrounds for the navigation header, overlays, or any surface that has content under it.
Apply data-testid to every button, link, and interactive element.
Make the design distinctive and bold, avoiding 'AI slop' generic centered designs.
Implement micro-interactions for all hover states.
Use generous padding (e.g., p-8 to p-16) to create breathing room.
Prioritize using HTML + Tailwind CSS for marketing layouts to ensure absolute freedom for asymmetry.
